sections.title: Where MiniMax H3 fits best
paragraphs: MiniMax H3 fits shots that benefit from broad framing options or a controlled final composition: fashion motion, product transitions, scenic wides and character beats with a defined start or end.
For image-to-video, the frame supplies the aspect ratio. Text-to-video exposes 21:9, 16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 3:4 and 9:16 directly.
bullets: Use 21:9 only when the composition has real horizontal action.
Use a final frame to control where the motion resolves.
Keep the prompt focused on the change between frames.
Treat 2K as a final render choice after motion validation.

rows: Uses the exact case-sensitive Kie values.
Upstream supports integer values from 4 to 15.
At least one frame is required for image mode.
The first release limits the UI to tested text and frame adapters.

sections.title: Describe the transition, not the still image

examples.label: Ultra-wide atmosphere
examples.text: 21:9 cinematic wide. A lone electric train crosses a salt flat at blue hour; the camera pans slowly to keep pace as distant storm light rolls across the horizon. Stable train geometry, restrained atmospheric haze, realistic scale.

examples.label: Frame transition
examples.text: The model walks naturally from the opening pose into the final frame. Fabric catches one soft gust, camera remains locked, realistic cloth weight, consistent face and garment details, no new accessories.

sections.title: MiniMax H3 versus the workspace catalog

faqs.question: Can I generate MiniMax H3 video here now?
faqs.answer: Yes. MiniMax H3 is preselected in the generator above for both text and image workflows. You need an account with enough credits.

faqs.question: Is the 2K option an upscale?
faqs.answer: The product sends MiniMax H3's documented 2K resolution value directly. It does not label a separate post-process upscale as native output.

faqs.question: Why does image-to-video hide aspect ratio?
faqs.answer: MiniMax H3 uses the supplied first or last frame to determine the image-led composition, so a separate text aspect choice would be misleading.

faqs.question: Does MiniMax H3 expose audio here?
faqs.answer: No separate audio control is currently implemented for MiniMax H3 in this workspace.
